judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: Plain, purely functional quest-giver talk (petition, ruby key, gate master) with inconsistent 'urchin'/'Urchin' capitalisation and a flat imperative journal line fits Nox's campaign texture; the 'foul little urchin' aggravating bats is mild Westwood-style whimsy rather than a crafted joke.
